    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="UserTask_ComplaintMail" targetRef="Gateway_BatchMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="SendTask_ReorderFastest" targetRef="Gateway_BatchMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" sourceRef="SendTask_ReorderCheapest" targetRef="Gateway_BatchMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_24" sourceRef="Task_ContinueBuilding" targetRef="Gateway_CompleteSplit"/>
